mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear over Badger Ridge Middle School, though the air quality is a bit high with an index of 51. It is a waxing gibbous moon phase, and you can catch the space station pass at 4:59 AM as it rises over Mount Horeb and travels toward the Home Depot near Madison, reaching halfway up the sky. Expect an overnight low of 48 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City is busy with updates on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, where underground utility work is finished and new gravel is down. Meanwhile, the Senior Center reminds everyone to order their daily grab and go meals in advance, and residents can use the Eye on Water program to track usage.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory today. Tomorrow, you can check out ART House 360 or trivia at Hop Haus. Later this week, enjoy music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square this Friday.

On October 15, the Verona Police Department responded to an incident where a school bus driver was arrested for operating while impaired; however, no students or members of the public were injured during the event.
Stop by for a scoop of today's Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor, but be sure to head over soon as the restaurant closes in 50 minutes.
